recentItems.title: CrystalClear Water by Adelle N - AI student project
recentItems.description:
This project was designed by Adelle a student of the AI education program at Coding & More and is for educational purposes only. It was also submitted by the student as her entry for the World AI Competition for Youth 2024. 

Adelle describes her project as follows - 
'CrystalClear Water leverages AI to enhance user experience and water quality. Our AI chatbot asks about your water source and recommends the best filtration product, ensuring tailored and effective solutions. For real-time support, our website's AI chat answers customer queries promptly. Additionally, our AI-equipped bottles monitor water quality, detect contaminants, and provide hydration reminders. These smart, integrated solutions ensure optimal filtration and convenience, promoting health and satisfaction.'

#aiforgood #aiunderstanding #design #designwithai #schoolprograms #eca

recentItems.title: AI Student Live Workshop - Nov 2024
recentItems.description:
At Coding and More, we host monthly live AI workshops that students from any part of the world can attend live online and have the opportunity to explore AI in an interactive format.

This year we have decided to have our AI students demo their own AI projects. Participating students can find inspiration and also follow along to try it out themselves! 

This month Mihaail, Miraaj and Izaan presented their fun and creative project called 'Snap Sketch' with the aim of helping users to practice their drawing skills in a fun way!

#ai #schools #k12education #global
